declarations.docstring: An auxiliary finite set of matrix-indexed finitely supported natural-number exponents.
The auxiliary exponent set has the displayed product cardinality when the coordinate sum matches the degree, and is empty otherwise.
The finitely supported antidiagonal over a finite index type has cardinality given by multichoose.
Under the coordinate diagonal action, each polynomial coefficient is scaled by the unit raised to the corresponding column sum.
The dimension of the indicated weight submodule equals the cardinality of the auxiliary matrix-exponent set.
The weight-submodule dimension is the displayed product of binomial coefficients when the total weight is the degree, and zero otherwise.
A coefficient of the polynomial associated to the degree representation is the displayed binomial product when its total degree matches, and zero otherwise.
The image of a weight submodule under the auxiliary polynomial embedding is spanned by monomials from the corresponding exponent set.
Membership in the auxiliary exponent set is equivalent to having the specified total degree and prescribed column sums.
Weight-submodule membership is equivalent to the embedded polynomial scaling by each coordinate unit to the prescribed exponent.
A monomial whose exponent sum is the given degree belongs to the corresponding homogeneous polynomial submodule.
For a positive number of choices, multichoose is an ordinary binomial coefficient with shifted upper argument.
An auxiliary linear map from the degree representation into matrix-variable multivariate polynomials.
The auxiliary polynomial map from the degree representation is injective.
Every polynomial in the image of the auxiliary map is homogeneous of the indexed degree.
The auxiliary polynomial embedding intertwines the two displayed general linear group actions.
A coordinate diagonal element scales a monomial by the unit raised to the corresponding column sum.
A finitely supported product of an updated function on second coordinates reduces to a power whose exponent is the selected column sum.
